core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Victorian aesthetics with modern SaaS functionality.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel like a ritual.
Content is King: The lore (Shigg, Cathleen, etc.) drives the design.
Negative Space: Use deep dark spaces to create mystery.
Contrast: Gold on Teal, Light on Dark, Rough Texture vs Smooth Glass.
anti_patterns: No pure black (#000000) backgrounds - use Midnight Teal or Deep Obsidian.
No flat gradients - use noise and texture.

headings.usage: Main page titles, Hero sections, Ritual names

body.usage: Long form text, lore descriptions, spell instructions

containers.ornate_frame: border-2 border-antique_gold/30 relative p-8 bg-midnight_teal/90 backdrop-blur-sm

buttons.ritual_primary: bg-ember_pink text-vellum font-cinzel tracking-widest hover:bg-rose_clay transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(185,78,106,0.4)] border border-antique_gold/50
buttons.ghost_gold: bg-transparent border border-antique_gold text-antique_gold hover:bg-antique_gold/10 font-playfair tracking-wide

cards.tarot_style: aspect-[2/3] bg-celestial_blue border-2 border-antique_gold/40 rounded-lg hover:transform hover:-translate-y-2 transition-transform duration-500 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden group

inputs.vintage_field: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-antique_gold/30 focus:border-ember_pink outline-none text-vellum placeholder-muted_brass/50 font-crimson text-lg py-2 transition-colors

home.layout: Full screen hero with centered ornate title, parallax scrolling into lore sections.

guides.layout: Bento grid of 5 columns (mobile 1), each representing a persona.

timeline.layout: Vertical 'Snake' line with alternating left/right cards. Each event card is an 'Ornate Frame'.

tarot.layout: Tabletop view, cards spread in a semi-circle.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Apply the 'Midnight Teal' theme globally in index.css.
2. Refactor the 'Button' component to use the 'Ritual' styles.
3. Implement the 'Bento Grid' for the Guides page.
4. Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds and placeholders.
5. Ensure all text is readable (WCAG AA) against the dark backgrounds - increase font weight if needed.
7. Do NOT use default Shadcn cards; customize them with the 'Ornate Frame' borders.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Dark colors must be rich (Teal, Obsidian), not just black.
